name: engraphy
displayName: Engraphy: associative memory for AI agents
description: Associative memory for AI agents, modelled on the human mind. Registers the self-hosted Engraphy MCP server with VS Code, plus a confirm-write queue and memory explorer.

engraphy.serverUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the Engraphy MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP). For a local bring-up this is `http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp/`; for a hosted deployment point it at `/mcp/` behind your TLS proxy. **Keep the trailing slash**: the server 307-redirects `/mcp` → `/mcp/`, and the redirect round-trip adds ~10s of latency per call (the extension normalizes a missing slash for you, but the default is correct as shipped).

engraphy.token.markdownDescription: **Deprecated, do not use.** The token now lives in the OS keychain (VS Code SecretStorage). Set it with the **Engraphy: Connect to a server** command. A value left here is migrated into the keychain and cleared on next activation.
engraphy.token.markdownDeprecationMessage: Storing the token here puts a live credential in plain text in `settings.json` and syncs it through Settings Sync. Run **Engraphy: Connect to a server** instead; it stores the token in the OS keychain.
engraphy.token.deprecationMessage: Deprecated: use the 'Engraphy: Connect to a server' command. The token is stored in the OS keychain, not in settings.

engraphy.space.markdownDescription: Optional label for the space this connection targets. **Informational only**: the actual space is determined by your `engraphy.token`. Used to label the server and the status bar.

engraphy.composeWorkingDirectory.markdownDescription: Working directory containing the Engraphy `compose.yaml` (and its `.env`). Used by **Engraphy: Start local server**. Defaults to the first workspace folder when empty.

engraphy.updateCheck.enabled.markdownDescription: Check once a day whether a newer Engraphy extension has been published, and say so when there is one. The check is a plain request for a public file and sends nothing about this machine or the installed version. Turning it off stops the daily check; **Engraphy: Check for updates** still runs one on demand.

engraphy.updateCheck.manifestUrl.markdownDescription: Where to read published version information. Leave empty to use `https://engraphy.tech/version.json`. Point it at your own copy to serve version information from your network.

steps.title: Welcome to Engraphy
steps.description:
Engraphy is a memory engine for AI agents. To use it you need a server to connect to.
There are three ways to get one; pick whichever fits.
[Connect to a server…](command:engraphy.configureServer)

steps.description:
